answer.reason: The verses state what the trumpets were made for and how they were to be used.

clauses.english: was made of one piece of silver to call the assembly and set the camps moving
clauses.quote: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them

clauses.english: was blown by the priests in war, so that Israel would be remembered before the LORD
clauses.quote: ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies

doubts: The trumpets are only commanded here, not described as used, so the clauses state their purpose rather than events.
